trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Leap
entries: The steeder can expend all its movement on its turn to jump up to 60 feet vertically or horizontally, provided that its speed is at least 30 feet.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Sticky Leg (Recharges when the Steeder Has No Creatures Grappled)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. {@h}The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and {@condition grappled} until it escapes (escape {@dc 12}).
